data.description:
## Description

What: Run the equivalence test against current main, identify every engine divergence, classify each cause (sequential-vs-parallel/TMPDIR contention, RED-zone asymmetry, or genuine logic), and either resolve it or scope-annotate it with rationale, yielding a documented zero-divergence baseline. Author docs/runners/classification-semantics.md recording the authoritative classification semantics (RED-marker tolerance, etc.), reference it from the manifest, and add an assertion so the equivalence test FAILS if that doc is absent. Why: sc-5 is the gate that must precede hook activation (sc-4) — the hard block is only safe once the baseline is zero-divergence and the semantics are authoritative. Scope IN: the audit run + divergence classification + resolution/scope-annotation with rationale; the classification-semantics doc; the manifest reference to it; the doc-presence assertion in the equivalence test; the green-on-main baseline. Scope OUT: wiring the pre-commit hook (draft-6/sc-4); regression snapshots (draft-7/sc-6).

## Done Definitions

- The equivalence test is green on current main with every prior divergence either resolved or scope-annotated with a recorded rationale, establishing a documented zero-divergence baseline ← Satisfies: sc-5
- docs/runners/classification-semantics.md records the authoritative classification semantics and is referenced from the manifest ← Satisfies: sc-5
- The equivalence test fails loudly if docs/runners/classification-semantics.md is absent ← Satisfies: sc-5

## Considerations

- [Boundary] docs/runners/classification-semantics.md must be added to the plugin-boundary allowlist before first commit.
- [Sequencing] This baseline must exist before draft-6 activates the hard-block hook.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a runner-contract maintainer, I want a baseline-equivalence audit and a documented classification-semantics reference, so that there is a documented zero-divergence baseline before the hard-block hook is activated.
